application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details required by condition 12 (CLC5 Condition - Analysis of soils and fills) of planning permission 21/03283 (Demolition of non-original elements including bay windows to front elevation, roof structure, rear elevation and rear ground floor extension. Lowering of existing lower ground floor level and creation of new lightwells to front and rear elevations. Creation of new basement level beneath house and part front and rear gardens. New rear elevation and rear extensions at ground floor level. New mansard roof with photo-voltaic panels and roof terrace. General associated alterations including re-landscaping of front and rear garden areas.)
